_note: Jobs for gen_codex_owner_sheets.py (2026-10-06). ref = [image in ~/art-references, crop box] or null; references are owner-licensed (docs/ART_LICENSE_CANDIDATES.md).

sw_unit_im_recon_squad.describe: a camouflaged military recon soldier in an olive helmet, goggles and breathing mask, with a long ragged cape
sw_unit_im_recon_squad.notes: keep the cape trailing in the walk; melee is a combat knife slash; ranged frames aim and fire a suppressed energy rifle.

sw_unit_im_signal_jammer_team.describe: a military signals soldier in a pale fur-lined armoured suit and helmet
sw_unit_im_signal_jammer_team.notes: add a compact jamming backpack with a short antenna; melee is a pistol-whip; ranged frames fire a small energy pistol.

sw_unit_nr_engineer_squad.describe: a combat engineer in an orange work jumpsuit with tool pouches
sw_unit_nr_engineer_squad.notes: melee swings a heavy engineering tool; ranged frames fire a short energy carbine; keep the tool belt.

sw_unit_nr_eweb_team.describe: a soldier in olive fatigues and a padded blast vest
sw_unit_nr_eweb_team.notes: the soldier operates a heavy tripod-mounted repeating energy cannon with a power cable: standing, idle and defend crouch behind the gun; move carries the folded gun on the shoulder; melee is a punch; ranged frames fire the tripod cannon; death slumps over the gun.

sw_unit_nr_heavy_weapons_squad.describe: a big, bald heavy-weapons soldier in grey and red armour
sw_unit_nr_heavy_weapons_squad.notes: restyle the armour as a rebel soldier's padded vest and fatigues in grey and blue; he carries a heavy energy cannon for the ranged frames, with a sidearm holstered; melee is a shoulder charge.

sw_unit_nr_hero_commander.describe: a rebel commander in a blue uniform jacket
sw_unit_nr_hero_commander.notes: melee is a close-range pistol shot or pistol-whip; ranged frames aim and fire an energy rifle; confident command posture when standing.

sw_unit_nr_slicer_team.describe: a technical specialist with tinted goggles and a gear-laden vest
sw_unit_nr_slicer_team.notes: melee jabs a handheld hacking probe; ranged frames fire a small energy pistol; keep a small data pad on the belt.

sw_unit_nr_rifle_squad.describe: a rebel fleet trooper in a white-and-black visor helmet, light blue shirt and black vest
sw_unit_nr_rifle_squad.notes: melee is a rifle-butt strike; ranged frames aim and fire an energy rifle.

sw_unit_im_decon_droid.describe: a bulky, slow industrial droid on short tracked legs with a dented ochre hull, a chemical sprayer nozzle and a heavy manipulator arm
sw_unit_im_decon_droid.notes: use the attached droid only for its bulk and pixel style; recolour it ochre and give it short tank treads instead of legs. Move rolls forward on the treads; melee swings the manipulator arm; ranged frames spray a greenish chemical mist from the nozzle; defend hunches; death topples over with sparks and smoke.

sw_unit_wl_vornskr.describe: a lean, wolf-sized four-legged predator with smooth grey hide, a long whip-like tail, a narrow toothed snout and pale eyes
sw_unit_wl_vornskr.notes: redraw it as a pixel-art beast walking on four legs: move is a stalking trot; melee-1 and melee-2 are a lunging bite; ranged-1 and ranged-2 are a whip of its long tail; defend recoils; death collapses onto its side.

sw_unit_wy_myneyrshi.describe: a lean, tall alien native with four arms and blue crystalline skin, wearing a woven loincloth, beads and feathers
sw_unit_wy_myneyrshi.notes: redraw it as a pixel-art unit with all four arms: it holds a long spear in two hands and a short bow in the other two. Melee thrusts the spear; ranged frames draw and loose the bow; keep all four arms visible in every frame.

sw_unit_wy_psadan.describe: a short, stocky alien native whose whole body is covered in overlapping grey stone-like armour plates, like a walking boulder, carrying a heavy wooden war club
sw_unit_wy_psadan.notes: it has no ranged weapon: ranged-1 and ranged-2 throw a rock overhand; melee swings the war club; move is a heavy, plodding walk; death crumbles to the ground.

sw_unit_im_at_st.describe: a two-legged armoured scout walker with a boxy angular grey cockpit head, chin-mounted twin energy cannons and thin jointed legs
sw_unit_im_at_st.notes: redraw it as a walking machine: move alternates its two legs (one leg forward, then the other); idle sways the cockpit head slightly; melee is a kick; ranged frames fire the chin cannons; death collapses with smoke and sparks. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_im_boarding_shuttle.describe: an angular grey military assault shuttle with folded wings, a heavy forward boarding hatch and twin laser cannons
sw_unit_im_boarding_shuttle.notes: it is a craft with no rider: idle hovers with engine glow; move flies forward banking slightly; melee rams forward; ranged frames fire the twin cannons; defend shudders; death breaks apart in an explosion. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_nr_boarding_shuttle.describe: a boxy armoured assault shuttle with stubby wings, white and blue panelling and a heavy forward docking hatch
sw_unit_nr_boarding_shuttle.notes: it is a craft with no rider: idle hovers with engine glow; move flies forward banking slightly; melee rams forward; ranged frames fire its cannons; defend shudders; death breaks apart in an explosion. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_im_minelayer.describe: a converted bulk freighter: a long boxy grey hull with open release bays along its belly and small gun turrets
sw_unit_im_minelayer.notes: it is a ship with no rider: idle shows engine glow and blinking lights; move flies forward; melee releases a mine from the belly bays; ranged frames fire the turrets; defend shudders; death breaks apart in an explosion. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_im_mole_miner.describe: a squat industrial mining craft with an ochre-yellow rounded hull, heavy armour plates and forward plasma cutting jets
sw_unit_im_mole_miner.notes: it is a ground vehicle with no visible rider: idle rumbles with exhaust; move crawls forward; melee and ranged frames fire the forward plasma cutting jets; defend shudders; death bursts into flames and smoke. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_im_star_destroyer.describe: a huge dagger-shaped grey capital warship with a stepped command tower near the stern and rows of turbolaser turrets
sw_unit_im_star_destroyer.notes: it is a capital ship seen from a three-quarter view: idle shows engine glow; move glides forward; melee fires point-blank broadsides; ranged-1 aims and ranged-2 fires turbolaser batteries; defend shows shield flashes; death erupts in chain explosions. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_im_tie_bomber.describe: a double-hulled starfighter with a ball cockpit beside an elongated ordnance pod, flanked by two bent solar-panel wings, dark grey
sw_unit_im_tie_bomber.notes: it is a starfighter: idle hovers with engine glow; move flies forward banking slightly; melee drops a bomb; ranged frames fire its lasers; defend shudders; death explodes. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_im_tie_interceptor.describe: a small starfighter with a spherical cockpit and two dagger-shaped bent-wing solar panels with wingtip cannons, dark grey
sw_unit_im_tie_interceptor.notes: it is a starfighter: idle hovers with engine glow; move flies forward banking slightly; melee is a strafing pass; ranged frames fire the wingtip cannons; defend shudders; death explodes. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_nr_docked_warship.describe: a medium-sized white frigate warship with a long hull, a rear engine block and docking clamps attached
sw_unit_nr_docked_warship.notes: it is a ship held in docking clamps: idle shows engine glow and blinking lights; move strains forward in the clamps; melee and ranged frames fire small point-defence turrets; defend shows sparks on the hull; death explodes. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_ob_dreadnaught.describe: a long, old-fashioned heavy cruiser warship with a weathered grey-tan ribbed hull, a blocky command bridge and banks of turbolaser turrets
sw_unit_ob_dreadnaught.notes: it is a capital ship seen from a three-quarter view: idle shows engine glow; move glides forward; melee fires point-blank broadsides; ranged frames fire turbolaser banks; defend shows hull hits; death erupts in chain explosions. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_ob_cloaked_asteroid.describe: a rough grey-brown asteroid shimmering faintly at its edges with a half-visible stealth field
sw_unit_ob_cloaked_asteroid.notes: it is a drifting asteroid, not a vehicle: idle and move rotate it slowly with the stealth shimmer flickering; melee and ranged frames flare the shimmer; defend shows rock chips flying; death shatters it into fragments. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_ob_cloning_cylinder.describe: a tall glass cloning cylinder filled with pale green fluid and a vague human shape, on a metal base with cables and pipes
sw_unit_ob_cloning_cylinder.notes: it is a stationary machine: idle and move show bubbles rising and the fluid glowing; melee and ranged frames spark its cables; defend cracks the glass slightly; death shatters the glass and spills the fluid. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_ob_shield_generator.describe: a squat armoured planetary shield generator: a grey dome on a fortified base with glowing blue emitter vanes
sw_unit_ob_shield_generator.notes: it is a stationary installation: idle and move pulse the blue emitter vanes; melee and ranged frames flare a blue shield arc; defend shows the shield rippling; death explodes with the dome caving in. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_unit_ob_shipyard_platform.describe: a large orbital shipyard platform: a skeletal grey framework with work lights, cranes and a half-built hull inside
sw_unit_ob_shipyard_platform.notes: it is a stationary orbital platform: idle and move blink the work lights and swing a crane; melee and ranged frames fire point-defence turrets; defend shows sparks; death breaks apart in explosions. Redraw it in the template's pixel-art style; the attached second image only shows its design.

sw_hero_pellaeon.describe: an older fleet captain with short grey hair, a lined face and a calm, tired expression, in an olive-grey military officer's uniform with a coloured rank plaque on the chest, a black belt, dark trousers and tall black boots, carrying a small energy pistol
sw_hero_pellaeon.notes: standing and idle stand straight with hands at the belt or behind the back, idle frames shift weight and glance aside; melee is a punch; ranged frames raise the pistol one-handed and fire a bright red bolt; move frames are a walk with alternating legs; defend braces and flinches; death frames fall and lie still.

sw_unit_im_officer.describe: a military officer in an olive-grey uniform with a peaked olive-grey cap, a small rank plaque on the chest, black gloves, a black belt with a holster, dark trousers and black boots, carrying a small energy pistol
sw_unit_im_officer.notes: standing and idle stand stiffly at attention, idle frames tug a glove and look around; melee is a punch; ranged frames raise the pistol one-handed and fire a bright red bolt; move frames are a walk with alternating legs; defend braces and flinches; death frames fall and lie still.

sw_unit_nr_field_medic.describe: a female combat medic with curly brown hair tied back, olive-green field fatigues, a white padded medic vest with two vertical red stripes, a shoulder satchel of medical supplies and dark boots, carrying a small energy pistol
sw_unit_nr_field_medic.notes: she has no melee weapon: the melee frames show her kneeling to tend a wound and standing up again; ranged frames raise the pistol and fire a bright blue bolt; idle frames check the satchel and look around; move frames are a walk with alternating legs; defend braces and flinches; death frames fall and lie still.

sw_hero_cbaoth.describe: a very old man with long flowing white hair and a long white beard, wearing a brown hooded outer robe over a cream tunic and dark boots, wielding a green energy blade
sw_hero_cbaoth.notes: standing and idle hold the green blade lowered at his side with a proud, stern posture, idle frames raise his chin and stroke his beard; melee frames swing the green energy blade in a wide arc; ranged frames thrust his free hand forward and shoot crackling blue-white lightning from his fingers; move frames are a walk with alternating legs; defend braces and flinches; death frames fall and lie still.

sw_unit_nr_militia.describe: a female resistance fighter with untidy brown hair, a sand-coloured scarf, a patched grey jacket under scavenged grey armour plates, dark trousers and worn boots, carrying a small energy pistol
sw_unit_nr_militia.notes: standing and idle hold the pistol low and ready, idle frames glance around warily; melee is a punch; ranged frames raise the pistol and fire a bright blue bolt; move frames are a walk with alternating legs; defend braces and flinches; death frames fall and lie still.
